summary: Descartes Systems Group filed a Form 6-K announcing its acquisition of Drivin, a Latin American last-mile delivery management platform. The up-front cash consideration is approximately US $30 million, plus a potential performance-based earn-out capped at US $5 million payable in fiscal 2029 if revenue targets are met. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or timeline details were provided. The deal expands Descartes' fleet performance offering and Global Logistics Network in Latin America, funded from cash on hand. Watch for integration execution and earn-out achievement as key risk-arb factors.
